headline: Gig workers are joining NPS steadily, says HDFC Pension CEO
hook: Aggregators drive pension adoption among gig staff
summary: HDFC Pension has onboarded gig workers from platforms like Zomato, Urban Company, and Goa Miles into the National Pension System. The company is currently in talks with additional aggregators and exploring partnerships with milk cooperatives to expand coverage. This trend reflects growing financial formalization among informal workers in India. For Indian retail investors, this signals expanding addressable markets for pension fund managers and financial inclusion plays.
why_it_matters: Pension managers tap a new vast retail customer base.
winners_losers: Pension managers gain / gig platforms expand social security
